title: Publish tests use a measured copy of the released contract and refuse missing or stale coverage
steps: Run the ops-quickstarts test suite against a scratch PostgreSQL database.
Repeat the suite with the clock moved 400 days ahead.
expect: Exact and lower contract versions publish with the expected warning behavior.
A contract without slot roles is refused for slot roles after coverage passes.
Missing or stale Content coverage refuses Publish and leaves GitHub assets unchanged.
evidence: CI run 40818273200 failed three Publish tests because the borrowed WordPress contract had no Content coverage measurement.
fence: A process-local contract copy carries a measurement pinned to its map and presentation lock; the production coverage reader and refusal remain exercised.
